title: Wildstrubel by UTMB — Race Regulations (official PDF)
claims: The published race regulation PDF describes a WILD 106 of about 106 km and 6,000 m of gain with a 26 h 30 min limit, a WILD 50 of about 50 km and 2,500 m with a 9 h 15 min limit, and a WILD 23 of about 23 km and 1,000 m with a 4 h 15 min limit, not the 110/70/55/Glacier/25/10 set on the current pages.
The regulation states that cut-off times are calculated so runners can reach the finish within the time limit and that runners must leave a checkpoint before its cut-off regardless of arrival time.
